# PkLavc Blog

> Stories and analysis by Patrick Araujo spanning engineering, games, digital culture, technology, and emerging ideas.

The main directory is at /blog/. Technology articles are under /blog/en/tech/, /blog/pt/tech/, and /blog/es/tech/. The games category follows the same language-first structure. Each article links to its sources; editorial labels distinguish confirmed reporting from leaks or theories.

## Start here

- [Blog categories](https://pklavc.com/blog/)
- [English blog](https://pklavc.com/blog/en/)
- [Blog em Português do Brasil](https://pklavc.com/blog/pt/)
- [Blog en Español](https://pklavc.com/blog/es/)
- [Games](https://pklavc.com/blog/en/games/)
- [Full article directory](https://pklavc.com/blog/llms-full.txt)
- [RSS feed](https://pklavc.com/blog/feed.xml)
- [Blog sitemap](https://pklavc.com/blog/sitemap.xml)
- [Public post metadata](https://pklavc.com/blog/posts.json)

## Editorial notes

- Treat article sources as the authority for claims; analysis and interpretation are labeled in context.
- LEAK and THEORY articles are explicitly marked and must not be treated as confirmed announcements.
- Prefer the canonical article URL when citing or indexing an article.
